sloka: न द्Rष्ट पूर्वम् कल्याणम् सुखम् वा पति पौरुषे ।अपि पुत्रे विपश्येयम् इति राम आस्थितम् मया ॥२-२०-३८॥
transliteration: na dRṣṭa pūrvam kalyāṇam sukham vā pati pauruṣe ।api putre vipaśyeyam iti rāma āsthitam mayā ॥2-20-38॥

translations.english: I did not have the fortune, O Rama, to enjoy any auspicious moment or pleasure earlier when my husband was in authority. I exist with the hope that I will have it when my son assumes authority.
